notes: Orbit 1.0.0, the first public release. A coordinated Omarchy desktop: a glass top bar with music controls, an agent studio and desktop pins that show your coding agents and their subagents at work, eight Vesper wallpapers with short animated arrivals, and a designed rain lock screen that shows what your agents did while you were away. Installs from one download without administrator access; the Orbit manager (Super+Space, Orbit) handles updates, repair, undo, enable/disable and uninstall while keeping your settings. Runs on x86-64 and ARM (aarch64).
